description: Library: devDependencies are pinned, runtime and peer ranges stay open for consumers. Every update goes through a PR that the main ruleset gates on the Tests and Mutation Tests checks.

packageRules.description: Supply-chain cooldown for npm. config:best-practices sets 3 days for the npm datasource in a package rule, which overrides the top-level value, so restate 14 days here. Pins stay exempt: they carry no release timestamp.
Automerge every aged, non-major update once the required checks pass.
Actions run in the publish job, which holds id-token: write for npm provenance: label them so they stand out.
Major updates only after approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
Raising the @playwright/test peer floor is a breaking change the maintainer decides (see .claude/skills/upgrade-playwright).
Stryker core, the TypeScript checker and the Bun runner are pinned exactly and must be upgraded together.
Playwright upgrades can add required FullConfig fields and new reporter API features.
prBodyNotes: Follow `.claude/skills/upgrade-playwright/SKILL.md`: run `task playwright:diff version={{{newVersion}}}` to review reporter API additions, and fix `test/stubs.ts` if `task typecheck` fails.

packageRules.description: Update the biome.json $schema version together with @biomejs/biome.

customManagers.description: Track the Biome version in the biome.json $schema URL.
Track the Renovate version that task renovate:check validates with.
